q: How many dollars of semiconductors were sold worldwide in 2025?
napkin: Roughly 1.2 trillion chips a year at about 70 cents each is on the order of $800 billion, and AI demand pushed 2025 well above 2024.
note: WSTS reports $795.6 billion, up 26.2%. The Semiconductor Industry Association's earlier February 2026 release said $791.7 billion before Q4 data was final.

src.label: WSTS, Global Semiconductor Market grows 26% in 2025

q: How many transactions did Visa process on its networks in its 2025 fiscal year?
napkin: Billions of cards doing a few purchases a week add up to hundreds of billions a year.
note: Visa counts payments and cash transactions on Visa-branded cards, plus Interlink and PLUS. Fiscal 2025 ended September 30, 2025.

q: What was the total payments volume across Visa's network in its 2025 fiscal year?
napkin: About 257 billion transactions at an average of roughly $65 each is close to $17 trillion.
note: Visa reports $16.7 trillion total volume. Its narrower payments-volume measure, which excludes cash, was $14.2 trillion.

q: How many vehicles did Tesla deliver in 2025?
napkin: Tesla delivered about 1.8 million in 2024 and sales fell in 2025, so somewhere around 1.6 million.
note: Down 8.6% from 1,789,226 in 2024, after the US federal EV tax credit ended on September 30, 2025. This figure comes from secondary coverage of Tesla's own release.

src.label: Not a Tesla App, Tesla Q4 2025 report

q: How many smartphones were shipped worldwide in 2025?
napkin: About 6 billion people use a phone, replaced roughly every four years, which is nearly 1.3 billion a year.
note: IDC's preliminary January 2026 figure is 1.26 billion, up about 2%. Omdia reported 1.25 billion.

q: How many people used at least one Meta app (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp or Messenger) on an average day in June 2026?
napkin: Facebook alone has about 2 billion daily users, and Instagram and WhatsApp add many who do not use Facebook.
note: Meta calls this metric family daily active people and reports it as a monthly average. It was up 3% on a year earlier.

q: How many people use Instagram every day?
napkin: Instagram has about 3 billion monthly users and around two-thirds use it daily.
note: Meta said Instagram reached 2 billion daily users during the second quarter of 2026. This comes from reporting on the results call, so check the transcript for the exact wording.

q: How many people use WhatsApp every month?
napkin: It leads messaging in India, Brazil and Europe, so well over a third of humanity.
note: Mark Zuckerberg said WhatsApp passed 3 billion monthly users on the April 30, 2025 earnings call. The real number today is probably higher, so consider replacing this with a newer figure.

q: How many domain names were registered across all extensions worldwide at the end of June 2026?
napkin: About 170 million are .com, and .com is roughly 40 to 45% of all registrations, which gives around 400 million.
note: Verisign's Domain Name Industry Brief reports 401.6 million, up 8.1% on a year earlier. .com and .net together were about 179.1 million.

src.label: Verisign Q2 2026 Domain Name Industry Brief

q: How many Starlink satellites are active in orbit?
napkin: SpaceX launches about 25 satellites per Falcon 9 and flies one every few days, so a few thousand a year, on top of the 10,000 reached in March 2026.
note: KeepTrack, a third-party tracker, counted 11,131 in orbit and 10,838 active in October 2026. Its catalog lags recent launches, so the true number is higher. This is not an official SpaceX figure.

q: What was the Bitcoin network's average hashrate over the 30 days to the end of August 2026?
napkin: It passed 1,000 EH/s in January 2026 and has been in the high hundreds since.
note: Hashrate Index gives a 30-day average of 912 EH/s and a 7-day average of 915 EH/s at August 31, 2026. Hashrate is estimated, not measured directly, so sources differ. One estimate for August 26 was about 860.

q: How many bitcoin have been mined so far?
napkin: The cap is 21 million, and about 95% of it was issued by the time of the last halving cycle, so about 20 million.
note: Mined supply passed 20 million in March 2026. About 450 new bitcoin are issued a day, so this number rises slowly. Estimates of coins permanently lost run from 3 to 4 million.

q: How much revenue did Nvidia report for its 2026 fiscal year, which ended in January 2026?
napkin: Nvidia made about $130 billion the year before and AI demand kept growing at 60% or more.
note: Up 65% from the previous year. Nvidia's fiscal 2026 ended on January 25, 2026.

q: How much of Nvidia's fiscal 2026 revenue came from its Data Center segment?
napkin: Gaming and other businesses are a small slice now, so most of the roughly $216 billion total is data center.
note: Up 68%. That is about 90% of Nvidia's total revenue of $215.9 billion.

q: How much revenue did TSMC report for 2025?
napkin: TSMC made about $90 billion in 2024 and grew by roughly a third.
note: NT$3.81 trillion, up 31.6% in Taiwan dollars and 35.9% in US dollars. This figure comes from secondary coverage of TSMC's results, so check TSMC's own release.

q: How many dollars of DRAM memory chips did the world's makers sell in the third quarter of 2025?
napkin: Memory is roughly a quarter of the chip market, and DRAM about two-thirds of that, so tens of billions a quarter.
note: TrendForce reported $41.4 billion, up 30.9% from the second quarter. SK hynix led with $13.75 billion and Samsung followed with $13.5 billion.

q: How many euros of net sales did ASML report for 2025?
napkin: ASML sold about 300 systems at an average of around €100 million, including EUV machines at far more.
note: A record, with net income of about €9.6 billion. EUV systems were about €11.6 billion of it.

q: How many people used ChatGPT every week in February 2026?
napkin: It had 800 million in October 2025 and was adding tens of millions every couple of months.
note: OpenAI announced 900 million weekly users and 50 million paying subscribers on February 27, 2026. A newer figure may exist.

src.label: TechCrunch, ChatGPT reaches 900M weekly active users

q: How many people used Spotify every month in the second quarter of 2026?
napkin: It had around 700 million a year or so earlier and grows by about 10% a year.
note: Up 12% on a year earlier. 300 million of them were Premium subscribers, and 494 million used the ad-supported tier.

q: How many paid memberships did Netflix have at the end of 2025?
napkin: It passed 300 million at the end of 2024 and added about 20 million a quarter at its best.
note: Netflix said more than 325 million, up from just over 301 million a year earlier. It no longer reports subscribers every quarter, so the exact figure is not public.

src.label: Netflix FY2025 filing and shareholder letter

q: How many articles does the English Wikipedia have?
napkin: It passed 7 million in May 2025 and grows by roughly 150,000 to 200,000 a year.
note: The count on the English Wikipedia page was 7,250,570 when checked. It changes daily, so update it from Wikipedia:Statistics shortly before publishing.

q: How many public models are hosted on the Hugging Face Hub?
napkin: It had about 2.4 million in January 2026 and has been adding over a million a year.
note: One third-party tally counts 3,012,377 on August 22, 2026, and Hugging Face's own summer 2026 report says about 2.96 million. The count is live and grows daily.

q: How many companies went public on US stock exchanges in 2025?
napkin: A normal year has 150 to 250 sizeable IPOs and 2025 was a recovery year.
note: Renaissance Capital counts 202 IPOs raising $44.0 billion. It excludes SPACs, closed-end funds and companies below a $50 million market cap, and other counts including SPACs reach 354.

q: How many exchange-traded funds were there in the United States at the end of 2025?
napkin: The US passed 4,000 ETFs in 2024 and new launches keep coming, so about 4,500 to 5,000.
note: The ICI 2026 Fact Book says 4,813 including ETFs that invest in other ETFs. An ICI FAQ page gives 4,495 for US-domiciled ETFs, so the definition matters.

q: How many dollars of venture and growth funding did startups raise worldwide in 2025?
napkin: Around 2,000 deals a month averaging ten to fifteen million each, with a few huge AI rounds on top.
note: Crunchbase says about $425 billion, with $211 billion going to AI companies. CB Insights says $469 billion and PitchBook and KPMG say over $512 billion, so every tracker differs. The Crunchbase figure here is relayed by secondary sources.

q: How much did Apple make in total net sales in its 2025 fiscal year?
napkin: iPhones are about half of Apple's sales, and 247 million iPhones at about $850 each is roughly $210 billion, so the total is about double that.
note: Fiscal 2025 ended September 27, 2025. iPhone was $209.6 billion and Services $109.2 billion. Up 6.4% on the year before.

q: How much revenue did Amazon Web Services bring in during 2025?
napkin: About $35 billion a quarter by the end of the year and less earlier, so roughly $125 to $130 billion.
note: Up 20% on 2024, with operating income of $45.6 billion. Q4 alone was $35.6 billion.

q: What were Amazon's total net sales in 2025?
napkin: It was around $640 billion in 2024 and grew by about 12%.
note: Up 12% on 2024. AWS made up $128.7 billion of it.

q: How much electricity did data centers around the world use in 2025?
napkin: The whole world uses about 30,000 TWh a year, and data centers are in the region of 1.5 to 2% of that.
note: The IEA estimated 416 TWh in 2024 and about 485 TWh in 2025, with 155 TWh for AI-focused sites. An earlier IEA rounding says about 500. These are estimates, relayed by Our World in Data.

src.label: Our World in Data, citing the IEA

q: How many people used the internet worldwide in 2025?
napkin: Eight billion people, and about three-quarters are online.
note: The ITU estimates about 6 billion, with 2.2 billion still offline. It revised its 2024 estimate up to 5.8 billion.
